sections.label: Setup
sections.description: A saved detector setup: choosing one fills each colour row with the setup's detector of that colour, and its file type becomes the routine.

sections.label: Routine
sections.description: The TTTR container type of the files (the reading routine).
Two colours: a donor row (G|G by default) and a FRET-acceptor row (R|G by default), each with its routing channels and its own photon-selection window.
The setup's detector each colour is read from.
Routing channels of each detector, comma separated.
Micro-time ranges of each detector: start:end; separate multiple ranges with ';'.

sections.label: Donor (G|G)
sections.description: The detector of the setup the donor photons are read from (G|G by default): its channels and micro-time ranges fill the row.
Routing channels of the donor row (G|G by default), comma separated.
Micro-time ranges for the donor row (G|G by default): start:end; separate multiple ranges with ';'.

sections.label: Acceptor (R|G)
sections.description: The detector of the setup the FRET-acceptor photons are read from (R|G by default): its channels and micro-time ranges fill the row.
Routing channels of the acceptor row (R|G by default), comma separated.
Micro-time ranges for the acceptor row (R|G by default): start:end; separate multiple ranges with ';'.
Three colours: B|B, G|G and R|G (by default). Their micro-time windows are the excitation periods of the PIE cycle, below.
The setup's detector each colour is read from.
Routing channels of each detector, comma separated.

sections.label: Blue (B|B)
sections.description: The detector of the setup the blue photons are read from (B|B by default): its channels fill the row.
Routing channels of the B|B row, comma separated.

sections.label: Green (G|G)
sections.description: The detector of the setup the green photons are read from (G|G by default): its channels fill the row.
Routing channels of the G|G row, comma separated.

sections.label: Red (R|G)
sections.description: The detector of the setup the red photons are read from (R|G by default): its channels fill the row.
Routing channels of the R|G row, comma separated.
The excitation periods of the three-colour PIE cycle: the blue pulse is seen by all three detectors, the green pulse by G|G and R|G.

sections.label: Blue excitation
sections.description: Micro-time range of the blue excitation period. Photons inside it are counted in every detector that can see the blue pulse.

sections.label: Green excitation
sections.description: Micro-time range of the green excitation period. Photons inside it are counted in every detector that can see the green pulse.
